pages.name: Sicilian: Closed, 6.f4 e6: 9.Be3 Nd4 10.Qd2
pages.notes: Plan 1 rerouted the knight via e1 to g2, where White's bishop stands. Rewrote plan 1 around Nd1 and c3; British spelling elsewhere.

pages.name: Sicilian: Closed, 6.f4 e6: 9.Be3 Nd4 10.Rb1
pages.notes: Plan 1 said b4 challenges the d4-knight (it undermines the c5-pawn that supports it); plan 2 answered b4 with ...a5 as a Black b4 move. Rewrote plans 1-2; British spelling in the overview.

pages.name: Pterodactyl Defense: Western, Rhamphorhynchus
pages.notes: Plan 1 recaptured with a knight via a6-c5 as one route, missing the usual ...Qxc5. Rewrote plan 1; British spelling elsewhere.

pages.name: Sicilian Defense: Acton Extension
pages.notes: Plan 3 traded the h6-bishop for a knight on f4 that isn't there; plan 1 'challenged' the bishop with g3. Rewrote plans 1 and 3 around ...Bxc1 once the d-pawn moves.

pages.name: Sicilian Defense: Hyperaccelerated Pterodactyl
pages.notes: Plan 1 rerouted a knight via f6-d7-c5 when no black knight stands on f6. Rewrote plan 1; British spelling in the overview.

pages.name: Sicilian: Accelerated Pterodactyl, 4.dxc5 Qa5+ 5.c3
pages.notes: Plan 2 developed a knight to c3, where White's pawn stands; plan 3's ...b6 was not this line's idea. Rewrote plans 2-3.

pages.name: Sicilian: Hungarian, 3.c3
pages.notes: Plan 1 wrote the centre as an e4-d4 route. Rewrote plan 1; British spelling in plan 2.

pages.name: Sicilian: Hungarian, 3.d4 cxd4
pages.notes: Plan 2 played ...Rc8 with the bishop still on c8 and called the c-file semi-open correctly but unreadably. Rewrote plan 2; British spelling in plans 1 and 4.

pages.name: Sicilian Defense: O'Kelly Variation, Venice System, Ljubojevic Line
pages.notes: Plan 1 named c6 as a weak square (the d7-pawn guards it). Rewrote plan 1 around a4 against the b5-pawn; British spelling in plan 2.

pages.name: Sicilian Defense: O'Kelly Variation, Wing Gambit
pages.notes: Plan 1 called the b-file open (it is half-open); plan 2 wrote ...bxa3 so it could not be read. Rewrote plans 1-2.
